prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: web page hero concept image
Primary request: A local AI creative lab interface on a dark workspace, showing an image analysis report, structured prompt cards, and concept art assets.
Scene/backdrop: restrained dark product workspace, practical panels, project folders, generated image preview.
Subject: a verifiable three-step multimodal workflow from screenshots to prompt pack to concept image.
Style/medium: polished editorial 3D illustration with realistic UI surfaces, not a screenshot.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, clear focal point, usable negative space on one side.
Lighting/mood: precise soft studio lighting, calm, capable, inventive.
Color palette: charcoal black, warm white, acid lime accents, restrained cyan details.
Constraints: no external API logos, no fake brand marks, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square assistant concept portrait
Primary request: An abstract Codex-like creative assistant presence for a local multimodal lab.
Subject: calm intelligent presence made from layered analysis panes, image tiles, and subtle light geometry, no literal robot cliche.
Style/medium: refined 3D concept art, premium software identity asset.
Composition/framing: centered 1:1 portrait, strong silhouette, readable at thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: quiet confidence, focused, imaginative.
Color palette: black glass, soft white, muted teal, small acid lime highlights.
Constraints: no text, no logo, no watermark, no human face realism.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: scene style frame
Primary request: A cinematic scene where raw screenshots and image references are transformed into structured storyboard panels and final concept art assets.
Scene/backdrop: local project studio with folders, analysis notes, prompt cards, and image boards arranged in a clean workflow.
Subject: the moment of transformation from visual input to Chinese analysis report to imagegen concept output.
Style/medium: sophisticated digital illustration, grounded product storytelling, not decorative abstraction.
Composition/framing: 3:2 frame, left-to-right process path, clear separation between input, reasoning, and output.
Lighting/mood: focused creative workshop, practical, elegant.
Color palette: neutral dark surfaces, paper white report panels, selective lime and amber signal accents.
Constraints: no external service logos, no random UI text, no watermark, no cluttered composition.
